biography: As a Datacenter and Site Acquisition Manager , I leverage my engineering and management skills to oversee the acquisition and integration of datacenter assets. With over 5 years of experience in technical infrastructure management and project management, I have successfully delivered complex projects on time and within budget. I hold an M.S. in Engineering Management from the University of Houston-Clear Lake and a B.S. in Chemical & Petroleum Engineering from the University of Kansas. My expertise includes utilities management, contract management, site selection, land evaluation and pipeline construction. I am passionate about driving innovation and efficiency in the datacenter industry.
